annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Justicia, Presidencia de la Nación (Argentina) – Derecho Fácil
key_provisions_or_claims: Public-sector AI projects should follow UNESCO ethical principles: proportionality, safety, fairness, human oversight, transparency, awareness.
Multidisciplinary teams should be formed before designing or deploying AI systems.
Decisions, actions and changes must be logged across the lifecycle to enable audits.
Responsible persons must act immediately on harm, with incident procedures and records.
Public bodies must offer a human, in-person service alternative.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Argentine government plain-language web page summarising Disposición 2/2023 of the Chief of Cabinet, which gives recommendations for public-sector use of AI. It stresses UNESCO-based ethical principles, multidisciplinary teams, traceability, incident response, human oversight and a human service alternative.
annotation.title_clean: Recomendaciones para el uso de Inteligencia Artificial
annotation.title_en: Recommendations for the use of Artificial Intelligence
